description: Inject browser context (cookies + localStorage) from a JSON file into a session or page's context. The file should follow Playwright's storageState format with cookies[] and origins[].localStorage[].

contextPath.description: Path to a browser context JSON file (Playwright storageState format)

pageId.description: Page ID — context will be injected into the page's session

sessionId.description: Session ID to inject into (uses active session if not specified)

name: inject_context
